requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Develop HP’s first business ink tank printer targeted at SMBs, offering high performance and cost efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: To fill the gap in HP’s portfolio and compete in the CISS PLE Hi segment, addressing evolving customer needs for cost-effective printing.
requirements.Dependencies: CISS technology, ink tank system integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer model released with ink tank technology, validated for SMB segment, and achieves lowest business TCO.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-powered productivity features for print, scan, and device management workflows.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need automation and efficiency improvements without dedicated IT teams; AI features will differentiate the product and address key pain points.
requirements.Dependencies: SMB portal, device management platform, AI software development
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features for print, scan, and support implemented and validated in MVP; measurable reduction in manual tasks.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage printers and devices, targeting office managers and generalist IT staff.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged/Lightly Managed SMBs lack dedicated IT; a portal simplifies device management and enhances customer experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software, device connectivity, AI integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal released with device management features, user tested by office managers/generalist IT, and receives positive usability feedback.

requirements.Title: Low Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO, including minimal intervention and maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs; lower TCO is a key differentiator against competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink tank technology, maintenance box design, sustainable materials
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO calculation shows lowest cost vs. competitors, validated through market analysis and customer feedback.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that can be serviced by customers, reducing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack IT support; customer replaceability lowers maintenance barriers and improves uptime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user-replaceable, instructions provided, and successful replacement validated in user testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent errors and ensure correct usage.
requirements.Rationale: Minimize user errors and support ease of maintenance for SMBs with limited IT expertise.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink bottle design, compatibility with printer
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles are keyed, tested for error prevention, and validated by customer feedback.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU with SMB Solutions
requirements.Description: Offer a Non-PDL SKU that supports SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, including PaaS support.
requirements.Rationale: Provide tailored solutions for SMBs needing advanced manageability and platform-as-a-service options.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU released with SMB solutions and portal integration; PaaS support validated.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance
requirements.Description: Provide a PDL SKU with improved speed (25/20 min) and support for PDL/PS and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Address performance needs for SMBs and ensure compliance with environmental standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Printer speed optimization, Blue Angel compliance
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU meets speed targets and passes Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Design printer with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor standards (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: SMBs value sustainability; higher RCP differentiates HP and supports environmental goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer contains 60% RCP, validated by third-party certification.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing functionality through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Office managers and generalist IT need easy, mobile access to printing solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is enabled, tested across major mobile platforms, and validated by user feedback.

requirements.Title: Warranty – 80k pages or 2 years
requirements.Description: Provide warranty coverage for 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require predictable maintenance and support; clear warranty terms increase purchase confidence.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms documented, tracked, and honored for all eligible printers.

requirements.Title: Serviceability – PHA and MINK
requirements.Description: Ensure serviceability with PHA (customer replaceable) and MINK at service center for out-of-warranty cases.
requirements.Rationale: Reduce downtime and service costs for SMBs with minimal IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Service center setup, replacement parts availability
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA and MINK service options available, validated through customer and service center feedback.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for device monitoring, usage analytics, and remote support.
requirements.Rationale: Enable proactive support and device management for SMBs, improving reliability and user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features implemented, data validated, and remote support enabled.

requirements.Title: Advanced Scan Workflow
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced scan workflow features powered by AI, targeting SMB needs for efficient document handling.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need efficient, automated scan workflows to reduce manual tasks and improve productivity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Advanced scan workflow available, tested for efficiency, and validated by user feedback.

requirements.Title: Solutions Monetization
requirements.Description: Develop mechanisms for monetizing solutions and services offered with Magellan over the next 3-5 years.
requirements.Rationale: Drive revenue growth and support ongoing innovation for SMB solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Monetization features implemented and revenue tracked over 3-5 years.
